from services.db import connect
from services.agents.supervisor import sanitize_for_cloud_llm

def dedupe_transaction(account_id, date, amount, description):
    normalized_key = f"{date}_{amount}_{description}"
    with connect() as conn:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        cursor.execute("SELECT id FROM transactions WHERE account_id = ? AND normalized_key = ?", (account_id, normalized_key))
        existing_transaction = cursor.fetchone()
        if existing_transaction:
            return False
        cursor.execute("INSERT INTO transactions (account_id, date, amount, description, normalized_key) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", (account_id, date, amount, description, normalized_key))
        conn.commit()
    return True
